entities.summary: John Milliken Parker Sr., was an American Democratic politician from Louisiana, who served as the state's 37th governor from 1920 to 1924. He was a friend and admirer of U.S. President Theodore Roosevelt. He participated in the 1891 New Orleans lynchings.
